targets.statement: 5 is the unique prime congruent to 0 mod 5; every prime p > 5 has residue in {1,2,3,4} mod 5.

targets.notes: Registry-citation grade for the labs' manifest firewall; near-instant for Aristotle.

targets.statement: Negation on ZMod 5 realizes the reflection element of D5 acting on the vertex pentagon: the map n ↦ -n is the automorphism of C5 corresponding to a reflection under Aut(C5) ≅ DihedralGroup 5.
targets.origin: BrockianVisualizer review — the corrected ZMod-5 residue map displays exactly this symmetry
targets.notes: Extends the proved aut_card_eq_ten / autEquivDihedral cluster; theorem-backs the D5 toggle idea.

targets.statement: The offset pattern {p_i − p_1 : i ≤ 9} ∪ {0} for the first nine primes covers both residues mod 2, hence is inadmissible: it has at most one prime translate.
targets.origin: BrockianSpiralPrimordialPrimes review — the component's fatal bug, formalized
